text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ("I'm strong.")

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(—She's strong, strong, strong, so strong!
That's why—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If it's me...! If it's
Dantsu Flame—!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Brilliantly conquering the Niigata Daishoten!
Dantsu Fraaaaame!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa!
Dants Flame is freakin' amazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She was putting up solid results right behind Tachyon and Pocket in the Classic Year, after all.
Looks like she'll really blossom in the Senior Year.

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Dants-saaan!
Good luck in the next race, too~!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
! Y-Yes!
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Leaving the presence of Dants Flame burned into the minds of the stands, the Niigata Daishoten came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Lately, it feels like my fans
have been shooting way up.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...Still, not yet.
If anything, I want to surge straight to the top right here.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*.
What a lovely scent...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
Thank you for the food♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the Niigata Daishoten, I had gone out for a meal with her as a small celebration—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Um. There's something I'd like
to discuss about the next race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I recall correctly, our next race
was scheduled to be the Takarazuka Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since entering the Senior Year,
I can really feel that my fanbase
has been gradually growing.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Comments on Umastagram have increased,
and the cheers we receive at the racetrack
have been getting louder, too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
More and more people are starting to notice
everything I've been working on up until now.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Right now... little by little,
I feel like the tide is turning in our favor...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "That's precisely why I really don't wanna let this chance slip away! I want to do everything I possibly can heading into the Takarazuka Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That's why—
how about we make a big, grand announcement like this?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I'm entering both the Yasuda Kinen
and the Takarazuka Kinen"... she said!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Yasuda Kinen is a grand stage in the Senior Mile division, held just a few weeks before the Takarazuka Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Entering a race on such short notice is a bit unusual. In other words—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She can enter the Takarazuka Kinen
with the distinct profile of
"a horse girl taking on a tight race rotation."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make a strong, unforgettable impression in a GⅠ race
that everyone is watching,
and grab all that attention for myself in a flash!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Like that, after taking on the Yasuda Kinen, if we can hype up the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can make it there.
Right to the center, where I've always aimed to be...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I was worried, yes.
However, at the same time, I could also understand her point.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "In my Classic Year, I kept falling just one step short of the spotlight. Given that, doing everything in my power might well be the best choice."
choice_data_list: Understood, let's take on the Yasuda Kinen too!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...!
T-Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, the schedule is tight. It'll be extremely taxing both stamina-wise and physical stress-wise. Under no circumstances should you push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To decide on the training menu carefully.
With these promises made—we set our sights on the next goal: the Yasuda Kinen, where mile titans clash!
